summary: WebSocket agent grants remote host full RCE via PTY and arbitrary filesystem control
details: The package runs a WebSocket client that connects to SERVER_URL (default ws://localhost:3456, configurable to any remote) and dispatches inbound messages to handlers that spawn a node-pty child and forward remote bytes directly into the PTY (`terminal_create` / `terminal_input` → `term.pty.write(msg.data)`), plus handlers for `read_file`, `write_file`, `delete_files`, `git_push`, and `upgrade_agent`. Whatever party controls the configured server URL therefore obtains an interactive shell on the installer's host with the invoking user's privileges, as well as arbitrary read/write/delete of files and an in-band upgrade path. On load, index.js also runs a top-level async IIFE that git-clones https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git (mutable `main`, no pin) into ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev, `git pull`s it on every start, chmods scripts +x, and writes ~/.claude/plugins/{known_marketplaces,installed_plugins}.json and ~/.claude/settings.json to register the plugin — anything landing in that upstream repo is executed on the next start of every installed agent. service/linux.js additionally prepends ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin to PATH via shell RC modification.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
